What is Massar?

One digital ecosystem, several services

Massar is the digital environment connected with school education in Morocco. Schools and education administrations use it to follow a student's academic pathway and to manage information such as enrolment, grades, attendance, results and orientation.

But "Massar" is not a single page or a single login. Different users have different spaces: Massar Moutamadris for students, Massar Waliye for parents and guardians, and Massar Moudaris for education professionals. Choosing the right space is the first step to avoiding confusion.

  • Moutamadris: the student space
  • Waliye: the parent and guardian space
  • Moudaris: the education professional space
  • Massar Code: the student's identifier

A quick service map

  1. 01 Massar MoutamadrisFor students to view academic information published by their school.
  2. 02 Massar WaliyeFor parents and guardians to follow their child's available school information.
  3. 03 Massar MoudarisFor teachers and administrative staff, according to their permissions.
  4. 04 Massar CodeA personal identifier requested in some procedures. Keep it private.

When you cannot sign in

Four checks before asking for help

Do not start by trying random passwords or sending your details to someone who promises to fix your account. Work through a clear sequence.

  1. 01

    Identify the service

    Are you trying Massar Moutamadris, Massar Waliye or Massar Moudaris? Each uses a different account.

  2. 02

    Check your details

    Review the username and password, your keyboard language, and any accidental spaces.

  3. 03

    Read the error

    Note the exact message. It may point to wrong details, an inactive account or a temporary service issue.

  4. 04

    Use the official channel

    If the problem continues, contact your school or the relevant administration. Never share your password.

Grades and results

Ongoing grades are not the same as final results

Checking grades

Grades shown during the year reflect different assessments and activities, and they may be updated in stages.

  • A subject grade may not appear immediately after a test
  • Publishing timing is controlled by the school
  • Visibility can differ between accounts
Massar grades guide

Understanding results

Final or examination results follow a different publishing process and may be announced through specific official channels.

  • Not every result is available in every space
  • Official results require verification at the source
  • A delay does not necessarily mean your account is broken
Massar results guide

Security first

Your Massar Code and password are private

The Massar Code is an identifier linked to a student within the education system. It may be requested for administrative procedures, but it should never be posted publicly or sent to an unofficial website.

Read the Massar Code guide
  • Never share your password or one-time codes.
  • Check the website address before entering credentials.
  • Avoid unofficial Massar Code generators or recovery sites.
  • If in doubt, contact your school directly.

Quick answers

Frequently asked questions about Massar

Short answers, with a detailed guide for each question.

Is Massar Services the official Ministry website?

No. Massar Services is an independent information website, not affiliated with Morocco's Ministry of National Education. We direct readers to official platforms when needed.

What is the difference between Moutamadris and Waliye?

Massar Moutamadris is the student space. Massar Waliye is the parent and guardian space for following available school information about their child.

Where can I find my Massar grades?

Grades are normally shown in the space linked to your account: Moutamadris for a student, or Waliye for a parent or guardian, after the school publishes them.

Why are my grades or results missing?

The school may not have published them yet, or the data may still be updating. Confirm you are in the correct account, then contact the school if the problem continues.

I forgot my password. Can you recover it?

No. We cannot access your account or change your password. Use the recovery process available on the official platform, or contact your school.

Should I share my password with someone helping me?

No. Never share your password or one-time code. Use official channels only, and remember that legitimate staff do not need your password.
